video:video.video:description: Understand why generative AI can produce confident but incorrect answers and how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding, source retrieval, and verification can reduce AI hallucinations.

video:video.video:description: Learn what the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is, why major AI platforms are adopting it, and how MCP enables AI assistants and agents to connect with tools, data sources, and external systems.

video:video.video:title: When NOT to Use AI : Why Your Instincts About AI Are Wrong : 3 Warning Signs You Should Never Ignore
video:video.video:description: Learn when AI is the wrong tool for a problem, including situations involving unreliable outputs, poor data or context, high-risk decisions, and tasks where conventional software or human judgment is more appropriate.

video:video.video:title: Why Your RAG Fails at Retrieval (Not the LLM) : Hybrid Search, Reranking & Agentic RAG Fixes (2026)
video:video.video:description: Understand why many RAG systems fail during retrieval rather than generation, and learn how hybrid search, reranking, retrieval quality, and agentic RAG can improve production AI systems.

video:video.video:title: The Terrifying Security Blindspot of AI Agents MCP Explained : The Developer's Survival Guide (2026)
video:video.video:description: Explore the security risks created by AI agents and MCP-connected tools, including excessive permissions, untrusted tool inputs, data exposure, prompt-based attacks, and practical controls for safer agentic AI systems.

video:video.video:title: The Ghost in the AI: The Terrifying New Way Companies Get Hacked : Prompt Injection : AI Security
video:video.video:description: Understand prompt injection attacks against AI systems, how malicious instructions can manipulate LLMs and connected tools, and why prompt injection is a major security concern for RAG and agentic AI applications.

video:video.video:description: Understand the AI cost paradox: model token prices may fall while total application spending rises. Learn the major cost drivers in LLM systems and practical approaches to reduce inference, retrieval, and infrastructure costs.
